name: San Justo de la Vega (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of green, yellow, red, yellow and green in the proportions 1:1:2:1:1.
history: The arms and flag of San Justo de la Vega were approved in 2005; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/6, 1/6, 1/3, 1/6 and 1/6, the outer ones green, the intermediate yellow and the central red.
